cohort.glrt_window_gate: robust line available and published margin gate passed

limitations: PSS residuals are timing samples while GLRT residuals are Hz; native RMS values are not directly comparable.
The normalized correlation is descriptive and does not establish statistical independence or physical attribution.
Both observables use the same raw IQ and candidate-only selection.
The PSS lock covers only the first approximately 6.9 seconds; 210 later continuity blocks returned no PSS result.
Absolute PSS carrier phase is unresolved and no payload was decoded.

method.comparison: native residuals retain different units; normalized overlays divide each residual series by its own RMS
method.cross_series_correlation: Pearson correlation after linear interpolation of GLRT segment residuals onto PSS block times; descriptive only
method.fit: Huber IRLS with tuning 1.345; degree fitted independently for each observable
method.glrt_observation: median robust_cfo_at_reference_hz within each continuity segment, from independent accepted 20 ms windows
method.pss_observation: median frame_phase_samples within each qualified continuity-safe PSS block
